sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Filter boxes: selecting the whole text (Ctrl+A) and pressing Backspace did nothing — the filter text stayed and the table stayed filtered. It now deletes the text and the table shows every row again. Selecting all and pressing Delete or Backspace very quickly could also empty the box without re-running the filter, leaving the table filtered on text that was no longer there; the filter now always re-runs. The "🔍 " prefix itself stays protected as before.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Columns split from a recording comment (Event-Type, Event-Country, …): new 📊 sections "Event info - Country form" (abbreviations such as USA, UK vs full names such as Denmark, so mixed spellings stand out), "Event info - Detail" (the text between the date and the colon, e.g. "early show") and "Event info - Additional info" (the "; …" text), each with has / none — counting only comments with an event type — and one entry per value.

An Event-Country of USA or Canada whose state is not a two-letter code ("…: The Roxy, West Hollywood, USA" puts the city in the state's place) is tinted light yellow with ⚠️ and listed in the ⚠️ WARNING menu (new setting "Highlight a missing state for USA/Canada as WARNING", on by default).
"rehearsal" is now an event type, so "rehearsal, 1978‐05‐19: Paramount Theatre, …" is split into Event-Type, Event-Date, Event-Venue, … like "live, …".

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Recording comments: a recording's disambiguation comment ("live, 2004‐10‐02: Gund Arena, Cleveland, OH, USA") is checked against https://musicbrainz.org/doc/Style/Recording#Live_recordings — "live", "live, 2002", "live, Los Angeles, CA, USA" or "<type>, YYYY-MM-DD[, early show]: Venue, City, State, Country" — with an optional "; more info" at the end and an uncertain day written "/23". The 📊 dropdown of the column that shows the comment (an artist's recordings' Name, a work's Recording, a release tracklist's Disambiguation) gets new "Recording comment info" sections: Form, Event type, Near miss (one entry per reason: date not YYYY-MM-DD, no ", " after the type, no ": " before the location, a type in capitals, a date with no type), Uncertain day, Additional info, and the same validity, date completeness, additional date info, location completeness and separator sections as "Live title info". Every entry filters the table. Behind the new settings "Unique-Values Dropdown: Recording Comment Info" (on by default) and "… Columns Holding A Recording Comment As Text" (default Disambiguation).

The comment cells are tinted like live titles (same two settings): light red with ❌ for an impossible date or a near miss, light yellow with ⚠️ for a plain "-" in the date. On a release tracklist the Recording date is compared with the comment's date: light red with ❌ when they differ, light yellow with ⚠️ when one is less precise or only one has a date (new setting "Highlight recording dates that disagree with the comment", on by default). Five new rows in the ⚠️ WARNING / ❌ ERROR menus.
